assets.prompt: Clean full-body character concept for a low-polygon video game, rendered like a studio turnaround model: simple solid shapes, clothing fitted to the body, no cape, cloak, skirt or loose straps, nothing dangling or thin, no fur, no transparent cloth, muted natural colours, flat even lighting, no text, no watermark, no signature. A lean unshaven man in his thirties as a highway bandit: a fitted padded gambeson under a short sleeveless leather jerkin, a plain belt with a sheathed knife, a short sword in a scabbard at the left hip, fitted wool hose, short leather boots, a hard wary face. Full body, standing upright in an A-pose with the arms held slightly away from the body, the legs straight and the feet a hand's width apart, straight front view facing the camera squarely, feet fully visible, nothing cropped, single subject centred, neutral mid-grey background, flat even lighting with no shadow on the background.
